query:
select
                tag.id,
                tag.group_id,
                tag.hidden,
                tag.name as "name!: DIS",
                grp.path::text as "group_path!"
            from product_tags tag
            inner join groups grp on grp.id = tag.group_id
            inner join group_adminships admin
                on admin.group_id = tag.group_id and admin.user_id = $1
            order by grp.path, tag.name::text
